_about: RedBridge Group/Accent Research (AFR) one-off and recurring survey questions that do NOT channel into the auspol-tracker data model (voting intention, 2PPs, PPM, leader favourability, vote softness, best-party/election-issues batteries, national direction). Compiled by reading every cached monthly tracker PDF text (glossary chapters at the end of each poll report) and the project's committed sidecars. Wave coverage: Nov 2025 through Sep/Oct 2026 fieldwork (10 cached PDFs). The March 2026 tracker wave (2026-03-27) has no published PDF page, the big March 2026 survey (N=5,563) lives only inside the cumulative 'Shifts in vote intention since June 2025' doc, and the Oct 2025 snapshot, May 2026 MRP and Australia Institute waves are separate products or non-cached — none are covered here.
_readme: Exit conditions confirmed before filing: the standing battery (federal vote intention + vote softness, leader figure favourability, institution/party favourability, issue salience, preferred PM, best-party battery) IS channelled into polls.json demographics/approval/ppm and data/issues.json. The May 2026 national-direction read (right 25/wrong 63) IS recorded in polls.json direction[]; the Nov 2025 and Jan 2026 reads of the same question are NOT, and are filed below. The April 2026 likelihood-of-voting battery (0-10 scale) IS recorded as the consideration map on the 2026-04-30 polls.json row — NOT filed below. Standing-but-unchannelled modules also NOT filed as one-offs: 'Favourability ratings of institutions/parties' (Labor/Liberal/National/One Nation/Greens — plus one-off guests: Advance Dec 2025, RBA Apr 2026, ABC May 2026 & Sep 2026, Medicare Aug 2026, NDIS Jul 2026) — every wave, so a series, not a wave one-off. The rotating per-figure favourability+name-recognition double (Figure/Table N pairs after the institution grid) is filed for Donald Trump alone (Jan, Apr and Sep–Oct 2026 waves): a recurring rotating module, filed at user request on 2026-10-17 as part of the cross-house Trump favourability series on /ad-hocs/; other figures' doubles stay unfiled. For Trump all eight net-column sections of the printed table are filed as per-section single-value tables.

entries.question: Here are some things that have been said and written about Pauline Hanson and One Nation. For each one, how much would it affect your willingness to vote for One Nation? (14 statements, two randomised batteries — 7 positive-ish, 7 cautionary — much more willing … much less willing)
entries.notes: Message-testing experiment. Strongest ON-growth levers: 'stands up for ordinary Australians on cost of living' (+27), 'will put Australia first' (+26), 'will reduce immigration' (+23), 'speaks her mind' (+23). Most damaging: the Iran-war link ('called for Australia to help Trump stamp out evil') -39, Trump admirer -38, penalty-rates vote -38, and no governing/budget experience -37. Pre-treatment willingness cuts are figures 49-50 (image-only).
